# Aurora Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Aurora. Thermostat service covers diagnosis, repair, and replacement of controls compatible with furnaces, boilers, and ductless systems.

Email: contact@auroraheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://auroraheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Aurora, Markham, Richmond Hill, Newmarket, Vaughan, Keswick, Stouffville, King City. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
